item.title: One Page at a Time
item.summary: A classroom notice explains how to use the shared printer and what to do when there is a problem.
item.content_markdown:
## Print your work

There is one printer for our class. It is on the table next to the teacher’s desk. You can use it before class or during the lunch break. Please do not print while the teacher is speaking.

Use the paper in the white box. Start with one page. Look at the page before you print the rest of your work. If the printer stops, ask Mr Karim for help. Do not pull the paper out yourself.

On Fridays, Mr Karim takes the printed work to the front desk at three. If you leave work on the printer, you can get it there after three. Write your name on the first page.

questions.prompt: Why did the teacher put up this notice?
options: To show students how to use the class printer
To ask students to buy a new printer
To tell students how to find another classroom
To explain a new homework topic
questions.explanation: The notice explains when and how to print and what to do if there is a problem.

questions.prompt: When can students use the printer?
options: Only while the teacher is speaking
questions.explanation: The first paragraph gives two times, before class and during the lunch break.

questions.prompt: Where is the paper for the printer?
options: In a bag by the door
questions.explanation: The notice says to use the paper in the white box.

questions.prompt: Why should students print one page first?
options: To put it in the white box
To check how their work looks before printing more
To show the front desk what they plan to print
To save a page for Mr Karim
questions.explanation: They should look at the first page before printing the rest.

questions.prompt: Students should pull out the paper when the printer stops.
questions.explanation: The notice tells students to ask Mr Karim for help and not pull out the paper.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentences with words from the passage.
questions.text: After three on Friday, students can get work they left at the front ___.
questions.explanation: Mr Karim takes the printed work to the front desk at three on Fridays.
